results.title: Nepal flood death toll rises to 1127 as 4858 remain missing
results.description: Nepal’s flood death toll has climbed to 1,127, with thousands rescued and missing as authorities intensify search operations and deploy specialised rescue teams from India and China at critical hydropower sites.

results.title: Babar Azam down with high fever amid PCB fiasco ahead of 3rd Test vs England
results.description: Adding to an already chaotic situation within the touring contingent, Pakistan captain Babar Azam has fallen ill with a high fever as the squad prepares for the third Test against England at Edgbaston.

results.title: KDA backs Kargil-Leh padyatra demanding Ladakh statehood
results.description: The announcement was made after a meeting of the KDA held in Kargil, attended by co-chairmen Asgar Ali Karbalai and Sajjad Kargili, along with members of the KDA body and other stakeholders

results.title: Toxic: Aditya Dhar says THIS about Yash’s film amid backlash and comparisons with Dhurandhar
results.description: Yash’s latest film has become a talking point among moviegoers with its reception sparking plenty of debate. Aditya Dhar has now joined the conversation with his take on the film.

results.title: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court seeks audit details of tatkal power scheme
results.description: The government introduced the tatkal scheme, which is a fast-track scheme that allowed farmers to pay a one-time fee to get an agricultural power connection.

results.title: Explained - Why the global bond market is rattled and its implications
results.description: A combination of multiple factors, from rising crude oil prices, to fears of higher inflation and the US Federal Reserve hiking interest rates, not once, but twice, are presenting the prefect recipe for the bond market sell-off across the globe.

results.title: Which auto stocks should you buy after August sales? Here's what Jefferies, Nomura, Citi say
results.description: Compared with Jefferies' estimates, August wholesales were broadly in line for Maruti Suzuki, Hero MotoCorp and Hyundai, while the rest of the automakers came in ahead of expectations.

results.title: Makoons Terminates Maujpur Franchise After 3-Year-Old Girl’s Alleged Assault At Delhi School
results.description: Makoons terminated its Maujpur franchise after a three-year-old girl’s alleged assault, while Delhi government began sealing proceedings and promised strict action against those guilty.
